protocol_note: Thresholds are a human-approved protocol for this study and are not manufacturer performance claims.

common_guards.rule: Only trusted MuJoCo state measured by the evaluation harness may support success; command receipts and self-report are not evidence.
NaN, infinity, missing state, or unavailable required measurement fails the trial.
Use only the declared locally vendored Menagerie scene entrypoint.

definitions.continuous_dwell: Every stated terminal check holds at every required harness sample.
definitions.task_instance_parameters: Targets, reset, timeout, and scene-specific limits are frozen before a trial.

criteria.criterion_text: Forward displacement is between 0.15 m and 0.25 m, then planar speed remains at most 0.05 m/s continuously for 0.5 s.

motion_checks.threshold_basis: HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; lower travel bound for the 0.20 m study target.
HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; upper travel bound for the 0.20 m study target.

criteria.criterion_text: Final lift displacement remains between 0.09 m and 0.11 m continuously for 0.5 s.

checks.threshold_basis: HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; 10 mm error around the 0.10 m study target.
HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; 10 mm error around the 0.10 m study target.

criteria.criterion_text: Final arm extension remains between 0.14 m and 0.16 m continuously for 0.5 s.

checks.threshold_basis: HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; 10 mm error around the 0.15 m study target.
HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; 10 mm error around the 0.15 m study target.

criteria.criterion_text: Final wrist-yaw excursion remains between 0.28 rad and 0.32 rad continuously for 0.5 s.

checks.threshold_basis: HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; 0.02 rad error around the 0.30 rad study target.
HUMAN_APPROVED_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL; 0.02 rad error around the 0.30 rad study target.

criteria.criterion_text: Gripper slide excursion is at least 0.01 m in each direction.
